Wird.title: Daily Wird
Wird.description: Your daily reading, saved progress, and khatmah plan in one place.

setup.nextPortion: Changes apply to your next portion. Today’s reading, saved position and completed history stay unchanged.
setup.planManaged: Your plan calculates this amount automatically. To change it, adjust the duration or reading unit in your khatmah plan.
setup.title: Set your daily Wird
setup.description: Begin at the start of the Quran and continue in order without losing your place.
setup.preview: {unit, select, ayah {{amount, plural, one {# ayah} other {# ayahs}}} page {{amount, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}} quarter {{amount, plural, one {# hizb quarter} other {# hizb quarters}}} hizb {{amount, plural, one {# hizb} other {# hizbs}}} juz {{amount, plural, one {# juz} other {# juzs}}} surah {{amount, plural, one {# surah} other {# surahs}}} other {{amount, number}}} each day
setup.success: Your daily Wird has been saved.
setup.error: We could not save your Wird. Please try again.

today.readyToComplete: You have reached the end. Mark this portion complete when you are ready.
today.confirmDescription: Confirm that you have read the entire assigned portion, here or outside the app. This records its completion and advances your plan.
today.acrossSurahs: From {startSurah}, ayah {startAyah, number}, to {endSurah}, ayah {endAyah, number}
today.carriedOverDescription: This portion is waiting from an earlier day. Complete it before moving forward.
today.readyDescription: Read at your own pace, then mark the portion complete when you reach the end.
today.scheduledDescription: Your next Wird is scheduled for {date}.
today.completedDescription: Beautifully done. Your next portion will be prepared tomorrow.
today.completeError: We could not complete this Wird. Please try again.

dashboard.emptyDescription: Choose a small daily portion and always know exactly where to continue.
dashboard.scheduled: Your next Wird is scheduled for {date}
dashboard.streak: {count, plural, one {# day in a row} other {# days in a row}}

history.title: A record of returning.
history.description: Every completed portion is kept here, so steady effort remains visible over time.
history.daysCompleted: {count, plural, one {# completed day} other {# completed days}}

reader.saveConflict: Your saved portion or position changed elsewhere. This tab has not overwritten it.
reader.draftRetained: Kept on this device for retry. It is not yet confirmed saved to your account.
reader.draftMemoryOnly: This attempt is kept only in this tab. Keep it open to retry.
reader.useLatest: Discard this attempt and load saved progress
reader.title: Today’s Wird
reader.saveAtAyah: Save reading place at ayah {number, number}
reader.saved: Your reading place has been saved.
reader.saveError: We could not save your reading place.
reader.finishDescription: When you have read the entire assigned portion, complete today’s Wird.
reader.empty: There are no ayahs in this portion. Return to the overview and update your goal.

Khatmah.title: A khatmah at your pace
Khatmah.description: Choose a duration. Your daily Wird adapts as you progress.

form.endDescription: This permanently removes the current plan, not just pauses it. Your current Wird, saved reading position and completed history stay safe. You can use the regular daily-Wird planner or create a new Khatmah later.
form.ended: Khatmah plan ended. You can now adjust your daily Wird.
form.restartDescription: This starts a new cycle from the selected surah and replaces the current portion, including its saved reading position. Completed reading and Khatmah history will be kept.
form.editHint: Your progress, history and current portion stay unchanged. Pacing changes apply to the next portion. Changing the number of weeks sets a new deadline from today (tomorrow if today’s portion is complete); otherwise your deadline stays the same.
form.repeatDescription: After each completion, begin again with a fresh {count, plural, one {#-week} other {#-week}} plan.
form.error: We could not save the plan. Please try again.

summary.weeks: Every {count, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}
summary.amount: {unit, select, page {{amount, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}} hizb {{amount, plural, one {# hizb} other {# hizbs}}} juz {{amount, plural, one {# juz} other {# juzs}}} other {{amount, number}}}
summary.adaptiveNote: Your next portion is recalculated after every completed Wird, so missing a day never leaves the plan out of sync.

history.title: Every completion leaves a mark.
history.description: Completed Khatmah cycles are preserved here, even when a repeating plan has already begun again.
history.duration: Finished in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
history.entryDetails: {actual, plural, one {# calendar day} other {# calendar days}} · {reading, plural, one {# reading day} other {# reading days}} · planned for {planned, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}
history.partialNote: Plans that began partway through the Quran remain in the timeline, but are not included in the completed-Khatmah total.
